disposition_reason: Ten commercial cod products (fresh, frozen, breaded, stockfish and salted baccala) bought in Messina were analysed for 21 elements; Table 4 prints means for each product.

study.design: retail survey of ten fresh and processed cod products (one product each, triplicate analysis)
study.market: local market and supermarket, Messina, Italy
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; ICP-MS (As, Cd, Cr, Pb, Ni, Sn, Sb, Se, etc.), ICP-OES (Ca, Fe, K, Mg, Na, P, Zn); total Hg by DMA-80
lod: LOQ 0.003 mg/kg for Cd and Pb, up to 3.383 mg/kg for K (Table S2, not in PDF)
study.qa: ERM-CE278k mussel tissue CRM with spiking for missing elements; recoveries described as good

findings.notes: mean ± SD of three analytical replicates of one homogenised product sample; basis not stated (muscle as received); total arsenic, inorganic fraction not determined
